title: The Bell Under Water
description: At low tide, a stairway descends into black water. A bell tolls below the last step.

branches.label: Descend toward the bell
branches.onSuccess: You find a submerged door and unlock it.
branches.onFailure: The water closes over your head. You return with black sand.

branches.label: Listen for the pattern
branches.onSuccess: The bell's rhythm maps a route through the city.

title: Market Gossip
description: Three merchants whisper about a door that opens only for people seen in the wrong place.

branches.label: Trade a rumour of your own
branches.onSuccess: The merchants point you toward the clockwork gardens.

branches.label: Leave before they learn your name
branches.onSuccess: You leave with your name intact.

title: The Garden Appointment
description: A clockwork flower has scheduled a meeting and sent three reminders and one threat.

branches.label: Attend the appointment
branches.onSuccess: The flower offers a seed that remembers the sun.
branches.onFailure: You arrive late. The flower makes a note of it.
